description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot using various speech and language processing services, including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language model interactions, with specific focus on function calling and transport configuration.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema defining a function for the language model, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining tools available to the language model, including standard tools like weather function.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns in the conversation to determine turn boundaries.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on Silero models.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame representing a run command for the language model pipeline.

classes.name: TTSSpeakFrame
classes.description: Frame representing a TTS output to be spoken.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its parameters for execution.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object holding messages and tools for the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for user-side LLM aggregation, including turn strategies.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Strategies for handling user turns, including stop strategies.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when to stop user turns based on analysis.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Function to create transport based on runner arguments and parameters.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch weather data via a callback.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up services, pipeline, and runs the bot asynchronously.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializing transport and starting the run.
